Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 57% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 8 o'clock, 12 o'clock and 4 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied TURQUOISE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright TURQUOISE sheen filling every gap. Where two regions meet, the leaf colours interlock naturally: flakes of one reach into the other and the two colours simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
